statements.t: "SS&C delivered another quarter of strong results, with Q3 organic revenue growth of 5.2%, record adjusted consolidated EBITDA of $674.8 million, and margins of 39.9%, keeping us on track to achieve our full-year goals," said Bill Stone, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.
